items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: And played with Louis Armstrong. Went from Russell to Armstrong. Armstrong took over Luis Russell's band. He conducted the band until he got ready to fire Luis Russell and then he fired him (inaudible). So I stayed on with Louis until 1940.

ctx.x: But, then you played with Luis Russell longer than that. You left the band in '31?

And played with Louis Armstrong. Went from Russell to Armstrong. Armstrong took over Luis Russell's band. He conducted the band until he got ready to fire Luis Russell and then he fired him (inaudible). So I stayed on with Louis until 1940. Then New Years we went down to Cafe Society with Red Allen downtown.

You've made a lot of records with the band, Pop's band at that time and I was listening to some of the things like I Double Dare You. You took a solo on that -- it's fantastic. As well as the things that you did like the band that Pops had where you recorded When The Saints Go Marching In.
